native_fields.method: Exact spherical face-area flux incidence using saved native CT faces; no midpoint reinterpretation of volume centers.

outer_two_active_radial_cells.scope: Final active-cell shell only; not the actual boundary ghost/Riemann trace or an all-history characteristic audit.

entropy_bound.bound_derivation: Amin=D*r0**(2*(gamma-1))*vmin**(2*gamma)/C**(gamma-1); speed interpolation is convex, initial radial T and n profiles cancel in A.
entropy_bound.assumptions: Ambient speed closure; no cones, heat losses or conduction; gamma constant. Smooth ideal flow transports A and physical shocks increase it. Open copied outflow does not prescribe a lower-entropy reservoir.
entropy_bound.interpretation: A violation diagnoses failure to preserve the physical lower bound. It does not identify the responsible discrete term, establish error at the comet, or require this scheme to satisfy a proven discrete minimum principle.
entropy_bound.snapshot_epoch: Final volume only at the recorded manifest epoch. Not an audit of all earlier states.

actual_trace_integrated_boundary_work.note: Undefined if CT work is zero but hydro-subtracted numerical work is nonzero; no artificial denominator

thermal.coverage: Final3D volume; accepted-step minima track density and pressure separately, not their cellwise temperature ratio at every prior state
